title: Commertize fee schedule
description: Flat fees for sponsors tokenizing a real-world asset on Commertize, and the minimum-investment rule.
notice: General information about how Commertize operates. It is not legal, tax or investment advice, and it is not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security.
principles: Flat fees, priced by complexity rather than asset value
No fee is tied to capital raised
Third-party costs (entity counsel, identity checks, network fees) are paid by the sponsor directly where possible, otherwise passed through at cost, itemized and never marked up

tiers.when: Single asset, single entity, single jurisdiction, up to 3 material contracts
2 to 5 jurisdictions, a multi-class cap table, 4 to 10 material contracts, or supermajority consent
More than 10 material contracts, a multi-asset portfolio, cross-border structure, or contested title

riders.name: Contract review beyond the tier baseline

setup.payment_terms: 50% at signing, 50% on delivery of the work product

reporting_fee.earned_on: delivery of each payment-file report (a reporting deliverable); the fee is not charged on, or measured by, any distribution or movement of funds

design_partner_option.notes: Tier 1 setup at a flat $15,000 with no riders, regardless of complexity, offered to a limited number of sponsors in exchange for a named reference and case study. Third-party costs at cost. Operations fees apply from the first distribution.

minimum_investment.plain: The minimum ticket is the largest of $5,000, the target raise divided by 1,500 (rounded up), and the issuer's own minimum.
